data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that verifies a real person is in front of the camera using liveness challenges and anti‑spoofing checks.
data.what_it_does: It runs a live camera feed and asks the user to perform random challenges such as blinking, smiling, or head turns. The package evaluates face quality, detects spoofing (screen glare, motion correlation, TrueDepth) and can generate a privacy‑preserving biometric template.
use_when: anti‑fraud flows that need to ensure a real user is present
apps that can request camera and sensor permissions on Android/iOS
avoid_when: projects with strict size constraints due to heavy ML dependencies
simple photo capture without liveness verification
strengths: 13 animated UI styles and full theming support
Multiple anti‑spoofing techniques (gyroscope, screen flash, TrueDepth)
weaknesses: Only works on Android and iOS
Requires Flutter 3.47+ and Dart 3.13+, raising the minimum SDK
Adds several heavy native dependencies (camera, ML Kit, sensors)
data.setup_notes: Add CAMERA permission to AndroidManifest.xml; add NSCameraUsageDescription to iOS Info.plist; enable Swift Package Manager (flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager) for iOS; include TTS query in Android <queries> if using voice guidance; ensure device has TrueDepth camera for 3D depth detection.
